text: Radio interface. When our cell phone sends information to the base station, we know now that cell phones are connected to base stations. It will send a wireless signal, right? A wave form, electromagnetic wave. The electromagnetic wave travels from this radio interface to the typically nearest base station. Now, this electromagnetic wave will bring the information from our cell phone to the base station. So the issue here is how can the radio interface, the cellular radio interface of our phone, impress the information on the electromagnetic wave that travels to the base station. Now the information that we want to transfer is digital information, right? So zeros and ones, let's say. So we need to impress zero and ones on the electromagnetic wave. How can we do that? We can act either on the amplitude of the electromagnetic wave. So modify the amplitude of the electromagnetic wave in a different manner depending on whether we want to send a zero or a one.
